content.text:
No, not yet. `src/services/user-service.js` still uses callbacks and calls `query`/`update` from `db.js` directly. A comment at line 3 says it's waiting to be moved over: *"Chapter 5 migrates this to UserRepository."*

`UserRepository` (`src/repositories/user-repository.js`) already exists, and each service function has a promise-based method that does the same thing:

| `user-service.js` (callback) | `UserRepository` (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(callback)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, callback)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, callback)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project has a `migrate-module` skill for this exact change. It moves one service onto its repository and then runs that service's tests. Want me to run it on `user-service.js`? Anything that calls these functions with callbacks, like `src/api/routes.js`, would need updating too.
